Job Code: MACIN13443
Role: Agentic AI Developer
Type of Commute: Remote
Skill Set: AI/ML, Agentic or autonomous AI, LLMs, NLP, TensorFlow, PyTorch
Desired Industry Experience: 4 years
Role Description:
About the Role
Macrosoft Inc. is on the lookout for a passionate and skilled Agentic AI Developer to join our innovative AI team. This role is pivotal in designing, building, and deploying autonomous, self-directed AI systems that enhance enterprise decision-making and user interaction. You ll work with state-of-the-art Generative AI, LLMs , and multi-agent frameworks to create cutting-edge, production-ready AI solutions.
Desired Skills:
3+ years in AI/ML or software development with a strong focus on AI systems
1+ year hands-on experience building agentic or autonomous AI systems
Strong proficiency in Python
Experience with agentic frameworks : LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, etc.
Deep understanding of LLMs, NLP , prompt engineering, and RAG systems
Familiarity with TensorFlow, PyTorch, ML algorithms , and deep learning principles
Cloud and deployment skills: AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes
Good knowledge of vector/graph databases , SQL/NoSQL systems
Job Location: India
